components.name: UtopiaButton

props.name: onTap
props.description: Called on tap, while isEnabled is `true`.

props.name: isEnabled
props.description: Whether the button responds to taps; visually dims via UtopiaGradientBackground when `false`.

props.name: loading
props.description: Replaces child with a UtopiaThreeBounce indicator while `true`.

props.name: dense

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Upper bound on the button's width.

props.name: colors
props.description: Overrides the default primary/accent gradient.

props.name: height
props.description: Overrides the fixed square extent (min/max height and min width). Defaults to 10x the token base when dense (40), 15x otherwise (60, matching a resting field's total height). Pair with maxWidth == height for a square icon button.

components.notes: The primary call-to-action button. Loading swaps the label for an inline UtopiaThreeBounce indicator while keeping the button's size stable; disabled dims the gradient fill instead of hiding the button.

components.name: UtopiaConfirmDialog
components.description: A themed confirm/cancel prompt drawn with the utopia card chrome - the same surface, border, shadow and radius as every other card - rather than a Material AlertDialog.

constructors.description: Creates a confirm dialog. Use show to present it as a route.

props.name: title
props.description: Dialog title, shown in `textStyles.header`.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Optional body copy, shown in `textStyles.text` below the title. When null, the dialog renders with no content section.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: Label of the confirming action button.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Label of the cancelling action button.

props.name: hasConfirm
props.description: Whether the confirming action button is shown.

props.name: hasCancel
props.description: Whether the cancelling action button is shown.

props.name: danger
props.description: Renders the confirming action in the theme's error colour, for destructive confirmations (delete, sign out, ...).

components.notes: A themed confirm/cancel prompt drawn with the utopia card chrome rather than a Material AlertDialog. danger renders the confirming action in the theme's error colour, for destructive confirmations (delete, sign out, ...). Use show to present it as a route with the ambient theme re-attached.

components.name: UtopiaCopyableText
components.description: A single-line, ellipsized text label that copies its value to the clipboard on tap, showing a tooltip with the full text and a snackbar confirmation once copied. Tints to the accent colour on hover so the copy affordance is visible before the cursor change. A `null` text renders as `-` and is not copyable.

props.name: text
props.description: The text to display and copy; `null` renders as `-` and disables copying.

components.name: UtopiaDatePicker
components.description: A tap-to-open date field: displays the picked date through a UtopiaTextField, opens an anchored calendar popover and offers a clear affordance via UtopiaRemoveIconButton.

props.name: date
props.description: The currently picked date; `null` shows the field empty.

props.name: label
props.description: The floating label shown above the field.

props.name: onDateChanged
props.description: Called with the newly picked date, or `null` when the field is cleared.

props.name: firstDate
props.description: Earliest selectable date. Defaults to 50 years before today.

props.name: lastDate
props.description: Latest selectable date. Defaults to 50 years after today.

components.notes: A tap-to-open date field: displays the picked date through a text-field trigger, opens an anchored calendar popover, and offers a clear affordance. The calendar grid is Material-owned and restyled from the ambient theme via utopiaDatePickerMaterialTheme, so re-theming affects it even though this component's tokenBindings list is empty (it reads no theme member directly).

components.name: UtopiaDialog
components.description: Adaptive dialog chrome: a bottom sheet on UtopiaPageType.mobile, a centered rounded card everywhere else.

constructors.description: Raw variant - full control of the body below the title row via builder.

props.name: title
props.description: The title shown in the header row, next to the back/close affordance.

props.name: builder
props.description: Builds the dialog body below the title row, given the UtopiaPageType resolved for the dialog's own available space.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum width of the dialog card on tablet/web. Ignored on mobile, where the dialog is presented as a full-width bottom sheet.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether the dialog can be dismissed at all. Controls the back (mobile) / close (desktop) affordance in the title row AND blocks route pops (barrier taps, Escape, system back) via a PopScope while `false` - so a `dismissible: false` dialog cannot be dismissed regardless of how it was shown.

constructors.name: form
constructors.description: Form variant - a sliver-scrollable sliver with a bottom bar pinned below it (typically the submit/cancel actions), built on top of UtopiaFormLayout.raw.

props.name: title
props.description: The title shown in the header row, next to the back/close affordance.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum width of the dialog card on tablet/web. Ignored on mobile, where the dialog is presented as a full-width bottom sheet.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether the dialog can be dismissed at all. Controls the back (mobile) / close (desktop) affordance in the title row AND blocks route pops (barrier taps, Escape, system back) via a PopScope while `false` - so a `dismissible: false` dialog cannot be dismissed regardless of how it was shown.

components.notes: Adaptive dialog chrome: a bottom sheet on mobile, a centered rounded card everywhere else. Two constructors share one build: the raw (unnamed) constructor hands the body to a caller-supplied builder (maxWidth defaults to 1000); the form constructor composes that same builder internally from a scrollable sliver and a pinned bottom bar (maxWidth defaults to 600).

components.name: UtopiaDivider
components.description: A hairline divider drawn in the theme's divider colour.
components.notes: A hairline divider drawn in the theme's divider colour. When UtopiaThemeColors.divider is unset, the colour derives from the theme's text colour over the surface, so it stays visible in any theme.

components.name: UtopiaDropdownField

props.name: onChanged

props.name: values
props.description: The selectable options, in display order.

props.name: label
props.description: The floating label shown above the trigger field.

props.name: valueLabelBuilder
props.description: Renders an option (or value) as its display text.

components.notes: A single-select dropdown presented as a labeled-field trigger with an overlay-anchor popup listing values. null can be a valid selection when it is present in values (e.g. a filter's "All").

components.name: UtopiaSearchField

components.name: UtopiaSwitch

components.notes: A general-purpose, data-shape-agnostic data table, generic over the row type. props.name: minWidth
props.description: The width a flexing column needs to stay legible - its footprint in the hidePriority fit check. `null` falls back to `UtopiaTable.flexColumnMinWidth`.

props.name: hidePriority
props.description: Give-way order when the table is too narrow: the highest value hides first, until the remaining columns fit. `0` (default) never hides.

props.name: sortBy
props.description: Client-side comparator selector enabling toggle-sort on this column.

props.name: searchBy
props.description: Client-side text selector enabling search matching against this column.

props.name: sortOptions
props.description: When non-empty, the header shows a dropdown of named orderings instead of the plain asc/desc toggle.

props.name: sortable
props.description: Overrides sortability detection - set `true` for columns whose sorting is executed externally (backend queries) and thus have no sortBy.

constructors.name: fixed
constructors.description: A fixed-width, non-flexing column - for icons, avatars or badges that should not stretch.

props.name: cellBuilder

props.name: width
